plugins.verifyConditionsCmd: (test -n "$WEB_EXT_API_KEY" && test -n "$WEB_EXT_API_SECRET" || (echo 'WEB_EXT_API_KEY and WEB_EXT_API_SECRET must be set to publish to addons.mozilla.org' && exit 1)) && (test -n "$CWS_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_KEY" && test -n "$CWS_PUBLISHER_ID" || (echo 'CWS_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_KEY and CWS_PUBLISHER_ID must be set to publish to the Chrome Web Store' && exit 1))
plugins.prepareCmd: npm run build && npm run zip && node .github/scripts/firefox-self-distributed.mjs ${nextRelease.version}
plugins.publishCmd: npm run zip:source && npx web-ext sign --channel listed --source-dir dist/firefox --upload-source-code myga-source.zip --approval-timeout 0 && (rm -rf web-ext-artifacts && npx web-ext sign --channel unlisted --source-dir dist/firefox-self-distributed --upload-source-code myga-source.zip --artifacts-dir web-ext-artifacts --approval-timeout 1200000 && mv web-ext-artifacts/*.xpi myga-firefox.xpi || echo '::warning::The self-distributed Firefox build could not be signed, the release has no myga-firefox.xpi') && (node .github/scripts/chrome-web-store-publish.mjs ${nextRelease.version} || echo '::warning::The Chrome Web Store upload failed, publish myga-chrome.zip from the release manually') && (node .github/scripts/edge-add-ons-publish.mjs ${nextRelease.version} || echo '::warning::The Edge Add-ons upload failed, publish myga-chrome.zip from the release manually')
